cells.quote: Youth with a 504 plan face fewer functional, social, and educational challenges than do youth with an IEP, but more than other youth without an IEP.
cells.note: The study text reports the comparative finding but does not provide a printed effect size or details about setting, duration, timing, age range, or expertise.
